تناوأت (form VI)
# تَنَاوَأْتُ (tanāwaʔtu) /ta.naː.waʔ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَاوَأَ (tanāwaʔa)
# تَنَاوَأْتَ (tanāwaʔta) /ta.naː.waʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاوَأَ (tanāwaʔa)
# تَنَاوَأْتِ (tanāwaʔti) /ta.naː.waʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاوَأَ (tanāwaʔa)
# تَنَاوَأَتْ (tanāwaʔat) /ta.naː.wa.ʔat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
